brief.title: Total this week's stock counts and flag items to hand out first
brief.plain_summary: Total the week's coded stock counts with the read-only tool, list items below their restock level and flag use-first items for a person to check.
brief.outcome: A draft restock and use-first list, with missing counts left as unknown.

stock_counts.description: Pin of a noun holding this week's stock count rows in the stock count sheet's columns, with no personal details.

use_first_days.description: Days ahead of week_of that count as the use-first window.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.restock-list's schema.

Every use_first entry has check_by_person true.

required: Total the stock_counts rows by item with the pinned read-only tool.
List every item whose total is below its restock level.
Flag every item whose date label falls within use_first_days of week_of, marked for a person to check. A date label is a prompt for a person, not a safety ruling.
Leave a missing count as null and list the item in missing_counts.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
